detail: M2 uses existing ablation data. 4-way comparison: Latent-WCT (single-shot WCT) vs a03_wo_flow (per-step AdaIN only) vs a01_wo_endpoint_adain (Flow only) vs Baseline (Full). No additional experiment needed.
Per-step AdaIN only (a03_wo_flow) CLIP-S=0.710 >> Latent-WCT (single-shot) CLIP-S=0.673. Per-step injection beats single-shot by +0.037, even without learned transport.
Flow only (a01) CLIP-S=0.708 ≈ AdaIN only (a03) CLIP-S=0.710. Individually comparable, but Full=0.727 > both. Synergy = +0.017 over best individual.
AdaIN only LPIPS=0.296 (lowest, most content-preserving), Flow only LPIPS=0.334, Full LPIPS=0.335. Flow adds style transfer power without content damage because AdaIN anchors HF stats.
DINO-C: AdaIN only=0.819 > Flow only=0.816 > Full=0.755. Full trades some content for style (DINO-S=0.484 highest). Pareto: Full dominates on style, AdaIN-only on content.
M3 HH_var anomaly investigated. Root cause: enable_hh_head=False → head_hh=None → Flow skips HH. M3 script bug: integrate_transport called without style_latent, AdaIN skipped.
HH subband is structurally isolated from Flow transport (enable_hh_head=False, head_hh=None). Wavelet decoupling is architecturally enforced.

refactor_clean_baseline (ep5): LH style_transfer_ratio=0.3065 (HIGHEST), HL=0.1858, LL=0.0559, HH=0.0000. LH (horizontal high-freq) is the primary style carrier, HL (vertical) secondary. HH frozen. LL preserves content.
M3 complete. Wavelet decoupling architecturally enforced. Style transfer in LH/HL (mid-freq), NOT HH or LL. Supports frequency-domain functional specialization claim.

no_adain (scale=0): LH ratio=0.0238, HL=0.0374. spatial_fiber_adain (scale=1): LH=0.2999, HL=0.2892. AdaIN provides 12.6x style transfer boost over Flow-only. AdaIN is the PRIMARY style injection channel, not redundant.

spatial_fiber_wct: LH=0.3264 (+8.8% vs AdaIN), HL=0.3266 (+13.0%). Full covariance matching slightly outperforms mean+std. But content_l2 increases (0.001065 vs 0.001039) and time +3.9%. WCT's covariance matching is a marginal improvement, not a qualitative leap.

per_subband_adain: LH=0.0873 (-70.9% vs spatial_fiber), HH=0.0985 (+20x). Per-subband decomposition redistributes transfer from LH/HL to HH, but total transfer drops sharply. Model trained with spatial_fiber; switching to per_subband at inference causes train-inference mismatch.

per_subband_wct ≡ per_subband_adain (LH=0.0873, HL=0.0978, HH=0.0985). With 4-channel subbands, 4x4 covariance matrix offers no advantage over diagonal (mean+std) matching. WCT benefits only emerge at full spatial fiber level (32x32).

M4 complete. Why AdaIN: (1) AdaIN is the primary style channel (12.6x boost over Flow-only). (2) WCT offers marginal improvement (+8.8%) at higher compute cost. (3) Per-subband decomposition causes train-inference mismatch. (4) AdaIN's mean+std matching is sufficient for 4-channel latents where covariance is near-diagonal. Conclusion: AdaIN is the right choice — simple, fast, and near-optimal for this architecture.

M1-M4 all complete. Key mechanism evidence: M1 shows LL gradient dominance (structural). M2 shows Flow+AdaIN synergy (complementary). M3 shows LH/HL are style carriers, HH architecturally frozen. M4 shows AdaIN is primary injection channel, WCT marginal. Paper claim should be: 'We empirically observe frequency-domain functional specialization' rather than 'caused by frequency dominance'.
